about: Do Or Donut LED matrix, extracted from the maker's Eagle board (original/donut.brd) by hardware/extract_matrix.py. One entry per LED. Positions are the LED centre seen from the FRONT, in mm from the board centre, x to the right, y UP; angle_deg is counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock. kicad_xy is the same point in the KiCad board file (y down).

driver.bus: private bus: SDA on XIAO D10, SCL on XIAO D3 (see README)

frame_note: frame = position in the chip's frame registers assuming the register row is the LED's CATHODE pin (the maker's schematic grouping). ctrl_reg/ctrl_bit = LED on/off register and bit (page 0..7), pwm_reg = PWM register (0x24 + index). If the datasheet puts the row on the anode, use frame_if_row_is_anode. TO BE CONFIRMED.
checks_passed: every LED is between two different pins of the same matrix
all 144 ordered pin pairs are different: 72 in matrix A, 72 in matrix B
every pin is the anode of 8 LEDs and the cathode of 8 LEDs
both frame mappings use each of the 144 positions exactly once
the maker's numbering LED1..LED144 follows the cathode-row order
